contract: docs/design-direction.md: optional Observatory and default Tasks project the same work items, preserve selection and status, and clearly identify sample activity.

accessibility.evidence: Native buttons have task-specific accessible names and aria-pressed selection. View switching restores focus; Tab reaches Observatory with a visible solid outline. Details expose role and access boundaries. Reduced-motion mode suppressed the handoff animation; normal mode produced one event animation. Screenshots were inspected in both appearances. This is a scoped prototype check, not a full accessibility audit.

responsive.evidence: Both views checked at 1024, 390 and 320 CSS-pixel widths without horizontal document overflow. Narrow workstations stack; controls and task inspector remain available.

loading.reason: This static sample makes no asynchronous agent or connector requests.

empty.evidence: Completing the Researcher task through the sample handoff and approving the Builder proposal leaves the Needs you lane empty with a No tasks label.

error.reason: This view change adds no fallible external operation or user-entered data. Runtime failures remain unimplemented; prior task-composer validation is recorded separately.

partial.reason: All task records are local fixtures. Partial retrieval and disconnected live-agent states are future runtime work.

success.evidence: Researcher becomes Done and Reviewer Working after the sample handoff in both projections. Selected task survives view switches. Reset, pause/resume, and return navigation were exercised without page errors.

permission.evidence: Builder requires the existing sample approval flow; approval changes its state to Queued in both views and explicitly does not start execution.

renderedEvidence.observation: Default task board with state lanes and the selected Researcher task inspector.
Four research-lab workstations, visible sample source handoff, and the selected Builder task inspector.
Light appearance with equivalent controls, readable activity, and task selection.
Full-page narrow capture with stacked workstations, wrapping handoff label, and reachable controls.
